subject: Request: encryption config snapshot + signed rotation ledger
messages:
From: LedgerBank Security <security@ledgerbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: encryption config snapshot + signed rotation ledger

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG review we need a short, self-contained evidence package showing:
- Current KMS configuration (policy bindings, key attributes, CMK metadata)
- Recent rotation ledger (last 12 months) with operator ids and timestamps
- Statement signed by your security/ops owner confirming BYOK/tenant-key handling procedures and HSM attestations (if applicable)

Can you send an export with a compact README explaining which keys are tenant-managed vs Redwood-managed and the in-transit encryption controls (TLS versions, cipher suites, mTLS endpoints)? LedgerBank prefers CSV + YAML + a signed PDF.

Target: we need this for our internal SIG audit by Oct 6; an initial package by Oct 2 would be perfect. Let me know if you need an NDA addendum.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Security Engineer, LedgerBank
security@ledgerbank.com

--
LedgerBank (external)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: LedgerBank Security <security@ledgerbank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: encryption config snapshot + signed rotation ledger

Samir — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes up front:
- We can provide an exported KMS config YAML and the rotation ledger CSV.
- For signed attestation, our Head of InfoSec (Irene) will provide the PDF; she'll include the HSM vendor and attestation dates where applicable.
- We will mark which keys are tenant BYOK vs Redwood-managed and include the TLS/mTLS endpoint list and cipher policy.

Plan:
1) I'll assemble the raw exports and a one-page README explaining mappings.
2) Irene will sign the attestation PDF.
3) Marissa will confirm the timestamp formats and scrub operational PII from operator comments.

Can you confirm that a Drive link + attached ZIP (YAML + CSV + PDF) is acceptable for your intake process?

Mina Haddad
Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Samir / Mina — attaching the signed attestation and the rotation ledger export. Notes:
- Signed statement (signed-kms-statement-20261001.pdf): confirms Redwood does not escrow customer tenant keys without an explicit contract; lists HSM vendor (Thales HSM v7.2) and last attestation date (2026-06-11).
- Rotation ledger (rotation-ledger-202608.csv): contains change records for the past 12 months. Operator IDs are pseudonymized to operator-xx (per our evidence handling policy) — raw operator mapping is available under an NDA and legal request.
- KMS config (kms-config-20260930.yml): includes key aliases, purpose, creation/rotation policy, and ACLs between tenant and system roles. Sensitive secrets (material key blobs) omitted.

A few operational clarifications for LedgerBank intake:
- In-transit: all control-plane and data-plane traffic is TLS1.2+; we require TLS1.3 for mTLS endpoints used by Dedicated & Private deployments. Cipher policy: ECDHE (X25519/P-256) with AEAD ciphers (AES-GCM/ChaCha20-Poly1305).
- Rotation cadence: default customer tenant keys rotate annually by policy unless an override is requested. Emergency rotation is logged via our rotation ledger and triggers a snapshot export.

Irene Choi
Head of InfoSec, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com

Attachments: signed-kms-statement-20261001.pdf, rotation-ledger-202608.csv, kms-config-20260930.yml

Thanks, Irene — that's very helpful. A couple of follow-ups after a quick scan of the artifacts you attached:
1) In rotation-ledger-202608.csv I see a column labeled "operator_comment" that contains ticket numbers and short notes. Those are fine, but can you confirm that no operator email addresses or PII are present?
2) For kms-config-20260930.yml: can you include a mapping table in the README that ties key aliases to logical tenant IDs (we only need the alias -> tenant-id mapping, not the tenant contact info)?

If you can provide a Drive link and a zipped package, we'll ingest it into our SIG tooling and follow up with any clarifying questions. Good to have the signed attestation as a standalone PDF — thanks.

—Samir
